verdicts.reason: A: the frame is left empty, so all the text sits right on the busy flower photo. 'Dear Gloria / you are invited to' has shrunk to unreadable size, 'beauty is skin deep' is broken into a narrow one-word-per-line column, and the flourishes are blown up out of scale. Still, the headline is big and readable. B is worse: the frame is again empty and pushed off to the left, the headline is small, and every line of text is jammed into one cramped stack over the busiest part of the photo with almost no contrast. The reading order is also jumbled: the headline comes first and 'Dear Gloria, you are invited to' comes last, and a flourish sits across the headline.
